chapter: Other drummers and New Orleans musicians
title: Joe Lindsey
summary: Bill Russell asks about Joe Lindsey; Jones knows of him but never heard him.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: There's another fellow who played drums, I never, I met him in Chicago, a friend of Louis Armstrong's, Little Joe Lindsey. Well I know of him.
Did you ever hear him on drums? I never did hear him. No, I never hear him either. I know of him but I know too much about him.
I think he worked at the Absinthe House was it?
Yeah, that's where I met him. I was introduced to him through Kid Howard. Kid Howard's the one introduced me to him.
I think Kid Ory once had him and his band in place of Henry Martin had been Ory's drummer but he seemed to like Joe Lindsey too I believe if I remember.
Well when Kid Ory was down here I don't remember Kid Ory.
No but I thought maybe Henry, I mean Joe Lindsey might have played quite a while later. You never heard him then in your time?
